svg.title: Arndt Bohrenkämper: personal LCARS logbook
svg.desc: Complete personal logbook of Arndt Bohrenkämper: personal background; AQVIONIS experimental AI-assisted security research; computing, AI, security and philosophy; Star Trek, retro gaming and martial arts; curiosity and lifelong learning. Readable desktop layout with orange and lavender LCARS rails on black.

g.aria-label: TO BOLDLY GO WHERE NO ONE HAS GONE BEFORE
g.title: TO BOLDLY GO WHERE NO ONE HAS GONE BEFORE

g.text: Personal log. I've spent a fair amount of time exploring the wonderful universe of
computers.
Some people collect stamps. I collect questions about how technology works. The
spare cables seem to accumulate by themselves.
My route hasn't followed a standard flight plan: entrepreneurship, leadership and IT
consulting.
The best discoveries often begin with a simple question: Why does it work like that?
Current interests: artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, Linux and connected systems.
Mission objective: explore AI-assisted detection of suspicious behaviour in
infrastructure.
Connect observations across systems and time to reconstruct attack paths and aid
investigation.
AI-assisted threat hunting and anomaly detection
Infrastructure, MCP and AI-agent observability
Threat graphs and attack-path visualisation
Counterfactual simulations
Long-term threat memory
Human–AI collaboration in security operations
Research is still in progress. This is not a production-ready security product.
Linux · Containers · Kubernetes · Automation · Networking
AI agents · Local language models · Machine learning · AI security
Threat hunting · Observability · Attack graphs · Security research
Intelligence · Consciousness · The origins and possibilities of life
The ship's computer is excellent at answering questions.
I find the unanswered ones even more interesting.
Exploration, science and imagining a better tomorrow.
Classic point-and-click adventures; the stranger the inventory, the better.
Hardware, operating systems and occasionally unnecessary experiments.
Shotokan Karate and Okinawan Kobudō (Jinbukan tradition).
Different disciplines, familiar lessons: patience, practice and attention to detail.
Stay curious. Learn the fundamentals. Question assumptions. Improve what you can.
Admit what you don't know. Then find out.
The universe is far too interesting to stop asking questions.
